title: 诊所护士来电说验血结果要回诊
titleEn: A call from the GP clinic about your blood test results
scene: 周五上午，你在上班时接到家庭诊所 Prospect Family Medical 的电话。打来的是诊所护士 Sue。上周你做了一次常规体检验血，现在结果出来了，医生想让你回来复诊，顺便再做一次空腹验血（fasting blood test）。Sue 语速快，还会说 results are back、nothing to stress about、pathology、a touch high 这类说法，而且诊所规定电话里不能详细讲结果。
你的目标：① 听懂是不是急事、医生为什么要你回诊；② 约好复诊时间（下周二下午 4:15 或周三早上），问清能不能 telehealth、要不要自费；③ 弄清楚空腹验血怎么做：几点以后不能吃东西、能不能喝水、去哪个化验点、要不要预约，并请对方短信确认。

facts.v: Sue：家庭诊所护士；你：上周做过体检验血的病人
铁偏低、胆固醇有点高，不紧急，但医生要当面讲
下周二 4:15pm，Dr Patel，标准门诊，bulk billed
前一晚 10 点后不吃东西，可以喝白水；化验点不用预约

vocab.ex: Hi, it's Sue from the clinic. Your blood test results are back.

vocab.en: nothing urgent / nothing to stress about
vocab.ex: It's nothing urgent, but the doctor would like to see you.
Dr Patel would like to go over the results with you.
Can I book you in for a follow-up appointment next week?
You'll need a fasting blood test before you see the doctor.
Nothing to eat after ten the night before, but water's fine.
The pathology collection centre is right next door to the clinic.
I'll pop the request form in the system, so you don't need the paper one.
It's walk-in only, so just rock up before nine if you can.

vocab.en: on the low side / a touch high
vocab.ex: Your iron's on the low side and your cholesterol's a touch high.

vocab.zh: 由 Medicare 直接结算，自己不用付钱
vocab.ex: Follow-ups with Dr Patel are bulk billed, so there's nothing to pay.
Sorry, I can't go into the details over the phone.

listening.en: Hi, is that Amy? It's Sue calling from Prospect Family Medical — have you got a quick sec?
listening.sound: have you got a quick sec 连读成 “hav-ya-gotta-quick-sec”；sec = second，一下下
listening.zh: 你好，是 Amy 吗？我是 Prospect 家庭诊所的 Sue，你现在方便说两句吗？
listening.reply: Yes, speaking. I've got a minute, go ahead.

listening.en: Your bloods are back, and Dr Patel'd like to have a chat about 'em — nothing to stress about.
listening.sound: bloods = blood test results（澳洲口语）；Patel'd = Patel would；about 'em 读成 “a-bow-dem”
listening.zh: 你的验血结果出来了，Patel 医生想和你聊聊，不用担心。
listening.reply: Oh, okay. Is it anything serious?

listening.en: I can't really go into it over the phone, but your iron's on the low side and your cholesterol's a touch high.
listening.sound: go into it 连成 “go-in-tu-it”；iron's 读 “eye-ens”；a touch high = 有一点高
listening.zh: 电话里不太方便细说，不过你的铁偏低，胆固醇有点高。
listening.reply: Right. So should I make an appointment to see the doctor?

listening.en: She's after a fasting one before you come in — so nothing after ten the night before, water's fine.
listening.sound: she's after = 她想要；fasting one = fasting blood test；water's fine 很快，像 “wor-diz-fine”
listening.zh: 她想让你复诊前先做个空腹验血——前一晚十点后别吃东西，喝水没问题。
listening.reply: Just to confirm, nothing to eat after 10 pm, but I can drink water?

listening.en: Collection centre's right next door, it's walk-in, just rock up any time from half seven.
listening.sound: rock up = 直接去、出现；half seven = 7:30（不是 6:30！）
listening.zh: 抽血点就在隔壁，不用预约，七点半以后随时去就行。
listening.reply: Great, so I don't need to book. Do I need to bring anything?

listening.en: I'll flick you a text with all that, and if anything changes just give us a buzz.
listening.sound: flick you a text = 发短信给你；give us a buzz = 给我们打个电话（us 其实指“我们”）
listening.zh: 我会把这些发短信给你，有什么变化就给我们打电话。

speech.topic: 我怎么照顾自己的健康（以及在澳洲看 GP 的经验）
paragraphs: Today I want to talk about how I look after my health here in Australia. When I first moved here, I didn't have a regular GP. If I got sick, I just went to any clinic that had an appointment. It worked, but every time I had to explain my history again, and it was a bit stressful.

A couple of years ago, a friend recommended a family clinic near my home. Now I see the same doctor every time. She knows my history, and I feel more comfortable asking questions. Most of my visits are bulk billed, so I don't have to pay anything out of pocket.

Last week I had a routine blood test, just a general check-up. A few days later, the nurse called me. My first thought was, "Oh no, something's wrong!" But she said it was nothing urgent. My iron was a bit low and my cholesterol was a touch high, so the doctor wanted to go over the results with me. I also need a fasting blood test, so no food after ten the night before.

To be honest, the hardest part was the phone call, not the results. The nurse spoke really fast. But I asked her to slow down, I repeated the important details, and I asked her to send me a text. That really helped.
So my advice is simple: find a regular GP, get a check-up once a year, and don't be shy on the phone. It's your health, so it's okay to ask questions.
speech.zh: 我刚来澳洲时没有固定的家庭医生，每次都得重新讲病史，挺累。后来朋友推荐了家附近的诊所，现在每次看同一位医生，她了解我的情况，我也敢问问题，而且大多是 bulk bill 不用付钱。上周我做了常规验血，护士打电话来时我第一反应是“糟了”，但她说不紧急，只是铁偏低、胆固醇有点高，医生想当面讲，还要再做一次空腹验血。其实最难的是那通电话——护士说得很快，但我请她慢一点、复述了重点、让她发短信确认，就搞定了。我的建议：找一个固定的 GP，每年体检一次，打电话别害羞，有问题就问。

patterns.en: My first thought was, "___!" But it turned out ___.
patterns.zh: 我第一反应是……，结果其实……（讲经历时很好用）

patterns.en: Just to confirm, ___, but I can ___?
patterns.zh: 我确认一下，……，但我可以……对吧？（复述注意事项）

patterns.en: Is there anything I need to ___ before ___?
patterns.zh: 在……之前，我需要……什么吗？（问准备事项）

patterns.en: Could you send me a text with ___, so I don't forget?
patterns.zh: 能把……发短信给我吗？免得我忘了。

lines.en: Hi there, is that Amy? It's Sue calling from Prospect Family Medical. Have you got a quick sec?
lines.zh: 你好，是 Amy 吗？我是 Prospect 家庭诊所的 Sue。你现在方便说两句吗？

lines.en: Yes, speaking. Hi Sue. I'm at work, but I've got a few minutes. Is everything okay?
lines.zh: 是我。你好 Sue。我在上班，不过有几分钟。一切都还好吗？

lines.en: Yeah, all good, nothing to stress about. Just ringing 'cause your bloods from last week are back, and Dr Patel'd like to have a chat with you about 'em.
lines.zh: 嗯，都还好，不用担心。就是打来说你上周的验血结果出来了，Patel 医生想和你聊聊。

lines.en: Oh, okay. Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower? The doctor wants to see me about my results?
lines.zh: 哦，好的。不好意思，能说慢一点再说一遍吗？医生是想因为结果见我一下？

lines.en: Sorry, yes — I talk a million miles an hour. Your blood test results are back, and the doctor would like you to come in so she can go over them with you.
lines.zh: 抱歉，对——我说话太快了。你的验血结果出来了，医生想让你来一趟，当面给你讲一下。

lines.en: I see. Is it anything serious? Can you tell me a bit now?
lines.zh: 明白了。严重吗？您现在能稍微跟我说一点吗？

lines.en: I can't really go into the details over the phone, I'm afraid — the doctor likes to do that herself. But between you and me, it's not urgent. Your iron's on the low side and your cholesterol's a touch high, that's all.
lines.zh: 恐怕电话里不太方便细说，医生喜欢亲自讲。不过私下说一句，不紧急。就是你的铁偏低，胆固醇有点高，就这些。

lines.en: Right, that's a relief. So when can I see Dr Patel?
lines.zh: 好的，那我放心了。那我什么时候能见 Patel 医生？

lines.en: She's pretty chockers this week, but I've got a quarter past four next Tuesday, or there's a nine-fifteen on Wednesday morning.
lines.zh: 她这周排得很满，不过下周二有个四点一刻的，或者周三早上九点一刻也有。

lines.en: Tuesday at four-fifteen works for me, I can leave work a bit early. Is that a face-to-face appointment, or could it be telehealth?
lines.zh: 周二四点一刻我可以，能早点下班。这是要当面看，还是可以视频/电话问诊？

lines.en: Face-to-face is best for this one, love, 'cause she might want to check your blood pressure while you're in. It's a standard consult and it's bulk billed, so there's nothing to pay.
lines.zh: 这次最好当面来，因为她可能顺便给你量个血压。是标准门诊，bulk bill 的，不用付钱。

lines.en: Great. And just to confirm, there's no fee at all?
lines.zh: 太好了。我确认一下，完全不收费对吧？

lines.en: Nope, not a cent. Now, the other thing — she's after a fasting blood test before you come in, so she's got the full picture.
lines.zh: 对，一分都不用。还有一件事——她想让你复诊前先做个空腹验血，这样她能看到完整情况。

lines.en: A fasting blood test. What do I need to do for that?
lines.zh: 空腹验血。那我需要怎么做？

lines.en: Easy. Nothing to eat after ten the night before. Water's fine — actually, drink plenty, it makes it easier to find a vein. No coffee, though, sorry!
lines.zh: 很简单。前一晚十点后别吃东西。可以喝水——其实多喝点，抽血时好找血管。不过不能喝咖啡，抱歉！

lines.en: Sorry, just to confirm — nothing to eat after 10 pm, water is okay, but no coffee in the morning?
lines.zh: 不好意思，我确认一下——晚上十点后不能吃东西，可以喝水，但早上不能喝咖啡？

lines.en: Spot on. So if you do it Monday morning, the results'll be back in plenty of time for Tuesday arvo.
lines.zh: 完全正确。所以你周一早上去做的话，周二下午之前结果肯定出来了。

lines.en: Okay. Where do I go? Do I need to book?
lines.zh: 好的。我去哪儿做？需要预约吗？

lines.en: The collection centre's right next door to us. It's walk-in, so just rock up any time from half seven. I've already popped the request form in the system, so you don't need a paper one.
lines.zh: 抽血点就在我们诊所隔壁。不用预约，七点半以后随时去就行。我已经把申请单录进系统了，你不用拿纸质的。

lines.en: Half past seven, right next door, no paper form. Should I bring my Medicare card?
lines.zh: 七点半，就在隔壁，不用纸质单子。我需要带 Medicare 卡吗？

lines.en: Yeah, bring your Medicare card, that's all they'll need. Is your mobile still 0491 570 236?
lines.zh: 对，带上 Medicare 卡就行，他们只要这个。你的手机还是 0491 570 236 吗？

lines.en: Yes, that's right. Could you send me a text with the appointment time and the fasting instructions, so I don't forget?
lines.zh: 对，没错。能把预约时间和空腹要求发短信给我吗？免得我忘了。

lines.en: No worries at all, I'll flick you a text as soon as we hang up. And if Tuesday doesn't work out, just give us a buzz and we'll shuffle it around.
lines.zh: 没问题，挂了电话我就发短信给你。如果周二去不了，就给我们打个电话，我们再调。

lines.en: Perfect. Thanks so much for calling, Sue. That's really helpful.
lines.zh: 太好了。谢谢你打来，Sue，帮了大忙。

lines.en: Pleasure. Don't worry too much, okay? See you Tuesday. Bye!
lines.zh: 不客气。别太担心哦，好吗？周二见，拜拜！

rescue.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，能说慢一点再说一遍吗？

rescue.en: Sorry, did you say a quarter past four or a quarter to four?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，您说的是四点一刻还是三点四十五？

rescue.en: Just to confirm, nothing to eat after ten, but water is okay?
rescue.zh: 我确认一下，十点后不能吃东西，但能喝水对吧？

rescue.en: Could you spell the doctor's name for me, please?
rescue.zh: 能帮我拼一下医生的名字吗？

rescue.en: Could you send me a text with all the details, please?
rescue.zh: 能把所有细节发短信给我吗？

checklist: 听到 "Your bloods are back" 能马上明白是验血结果出来了
能分清 nothing urgent / nothing to stress about，知道这不是坏消息
能听懂 on the low side、a touch high 这种轻描淡写的说法
能用一句话复述空腹要求："Nothing to eat after ten, water's fine, no coffee."
听到 half seven、a quarter past four 能马上换算成准确时间
能主动问清是否 bulk billed、要不要预约，并请对方短信确认
